# DefinitionIssue

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

One problem found in a definition, located by JSON Pointer (RFC 6901).

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Implements `IEquatable<DefinitionIssue>`.

```csharp
new DefinitionIssue(string Path, string Code, string Message)
```

## Properties

- [`Code`](#code): A stable, kebab-case code; see the Document Definition specification.
- [`Expected`](#expected): What would have been valid.
- [`Found`](#found): What was there.
- [`Id`](#id): The `id` of the element the problem is in, when it has one.
- [`Message`](#message): English text for a person.
- [`Path`](#path): JSON Pointer to the value at fault; empty is the whole document.
- [`Since`](#since): The minor version that introduced an item the reader knows but the document's version does not include, when the reader can tell.
